I spend a couple hours on this one only to try again the next day and fixed it within a minute.

I have audio routed from my mobo through a (usb 2.0) Scarlett 8i6 interface to speakers. My system was working well until I added two new monitors via DVI and set everything back up.

I could play a song for less than a second with audio until it would cut out. Window's Playback Devices shows the level freezes. Disabling/Enabling the device worked briefly. Changing primary device worked briefly. Even clicking around a youtube video worked briefly.

My guess is that the audio interface (in its current firmware?) doesn't know how to interact with the 3.0 port, because when I changed back to a 2.0 port, it starting working normally. Typing the first couple of lines made me realize I didn't try checking layer 1 yet...
